focus: This update was about making it easier to see what we ship. Our changelog is now searchable and filterable by year, every entry has its own shareable link, and clicking the latest line on the homepage takes you straight to that update. The homepage live-activity line now reads in plain language instead of developer shorthand. We also renamed our football game from VaultSpark Football GM to Franchise Architect — a cleaner name we can grow across every sport — and the old links redirect to the new ones automatically. Retired names now get a public tombstone pointing to what they became, so our history stays honest. And the changelog will now stay current going forward. PREVIOUS: This session was a clean recovery. A previous automated work session had finished six behind-the-scenes repairs but was cut off before saving them; we verified each repair actually worked rather than taking the earlier session's word for it, caught and fixed one mistake it had left behind, and saved everything as one clearly-labelled checkpoint.
